test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
What is the meaning of the word **"emerge"** in the sentence:

"Habits, scientists say, emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort."

options.text: To come into existence or become known

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. to come into existence or become known.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"emerge"** means:

 
 
• To come out into view, become apparent, or come into existence; to become known. (उभरना, प्रकट होना)
 
 
 
• In the sentence provided, "Habits, scientists say, emerge because the brain is constantly looking for ways to save effort," "emerge" implies that habits come into existence, develop, or become known as a way for the brain to save effort.

Therefore, the meaning of "emerge" in the given sentence is: **to come into existence or become known.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options and their meanings:

 
• **To disappear gradually** (धीरे-धीरे गायब होना): To fade away or vanish over time.
 
• **To remain unchanged** (अपरिवर्तित रहना): To stay the same without any alteration.
 
• **To move backward** (पीछे हटना): To retreat or go in the opposite direction.

b5:Tc01,

The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. initiator.
